author: mareldmon590
quote: When a parody game does things so well, it blows its original inspiration out the water. Gripping, hilarious, and poignant, download yourself SG, bring your friends into the vc, and play together for an unforgettable and precious experience.

author: mareldmon590
quote: Peak Fiction. Every sensitive young yearning man should give this visual novel a play, it's frequently enough on sale, and gift it to your friends if you can, they won't be disappointed.

author: mareldmon590
quote: A must-have if you are a Switch 2 user, and one of the best RPGs and strategy games of 2026. The stories, presentation, vocal performances, combat, and unit feel are among the best in the franchise. IS should be proud of what they accomplished with this game.

author: mareldmon590
quote: From start to finish, this was a 10/10 experience. While the other versions of the game hold up, everything about this one make it infinitely more worth playing, from the art direction, music, and fully-realized combat. A contender for being one of the best games of 2026, by a long mile.

quote: Had to sneak out of my longhouse to write this review. Jason deserves better, and Lucia deserves less.
